name: Rights holder

title: "Credit or removal: "

Thank you for telling us. Every photo in the app shows its author and licence; this form is for when one is wrong, or
when you want a photo or text taken out. Everything you write here is public: please give links, not documents,
addresses or phone numbers.

## What is it about?

- [ ] Change a credit or a licence
- [ ] Remove a photo
- [ ] Remove or change a text

## Where is it?

The link to the photo or page (the address of the page in the app, or of the photo), and what the app shows now:

## What should it say, or what is your claim?

The author's name as it should appear, the licence, and the link where it can be checked (for example your
iNaturalist observation or your own page). For a removal, say that you are the author or the rights holder.

## Anything else
